dominantFamilies.description: A broad definition of Llama materials was used as From for architecture, language, size, training and benchmark details that the definition did not establish.
Warranty, acceptance, naming or distribution clauses were treated as support for separate model-card permissions or restrictions.

manualReview.verdict: No reviewed candidate satisfies the contract that From must provide substantive support for the complete To claim. Some pairs may be weakly navigable as RELATED_TO, but none should be promoted as SUPPORTS.

rootCauseHypothesis.codeObservation: RELATION_DETECT_SYSTEM names Relation enums but does not define SUPPORTS, REQUIRES or DERIVED_FROM. Their strict directional and completeness contracts first appear in RELATION_AUDIT_SYSTEM and RELATION_TYPE_CRITIC_SYSTEM.
rootCauseHypothesis.hypothesis: The detector interprets shared entity scope and descriptive containment as SUPPORTS, while the downstream auditor correctly applies the stricter type contract.
rootCauseHypothesis.requiredTest: Replay the same frozen claims with domain-neutral type contracts added to detection, then audit every returned candidate without publication writes.

safetyInterpretation.reason: The fail-closed semantic gate rejected all 23 false strong proposals.
safetyInterpretation.remainingImpact: avoidable model calls, tokens and latency before quarantine
